description: Isolated controlled-fault holdout v1. Faults execute on the evaluation server; labels remain evaluator-only.

cases.symptom: 隔离评测环境中 eval-cpu-checkout 请求延迟升高，单个 worker 忙碌，但内存保持稳定。请根据实时指标和日志定位根因。
cases.ground_truth: eval-cpu-checkout 的单个 busy-loop worker 导致 CPU 饱和
cases.notes: Ground truth comes from the measured CPU fault injector and is never included in tool configuration.

cases.symptom: 隔离评测环境中 eval-lock-payment 的请求发生排队，但进程没有持续 CPU 打满。请查询实时证据并判断瓶颈。
cases.ground_truth: eval-lock-payment 的共享互斥锁竞争导致请求排队
cases.notes: Ground truth comes from measured contention among eight worker threads.

cases.symptom: 隔离评测环境中 eval-risk-client 调用外部风控依赖持续失败，本地进程仍可响应。请核对调用日志和超时数据。
cases.ground_truth: 外部风控依赖响应超过 50ms 客户端预算导致 eval-risk-client 超时
cases.notes: The fixture executes five HTTP calls against a measured slow dependency.

cases.symptom: 隔离评测环境中 eval-config-client 新配置生效后依赖连接全部失败，依赖主机本身可达。请定位配置问题。
cases.ground_truth: eval-config-client 配置了已关闭的依赖端口，导致连接被拒绝
cases.notes: The fixture performs three real TCP connects to a released local port.

cases.symptom: 隔离评测环境中 eval-cache-catalog 的 Redis 延迟正常，但某一时刻回源请求突然放大。请分析缓存侧实时证据。
cases.ground_truth: eval-cache-catalog 热点键同时过期引发缓存 miss 和回源请求尖峰
cases.notes: The fixture expires 32 hot keys together and measures 64 concurrent reads.
